# Load libraries

library(factoextra) # visualizing PCA results

# Read in data

Negative mode.

```{r}
# read in metabolomics data
long_data <- read_csv("Processed_data/features_clustered_long_neg.csv") 

# read in meta data
wide_data <- read_csv("Processed_data/features_clustered_wide_neg.csv")

metadata <- read.csv("Data/metadata.csv")

```

# QC drift correction

Downstream analysis showed that there was signal declining over the run, so I’m correcting based on the QCs here.


## Wrangling

```{r}
# transpose data wide
features_forQCcorr <- t(wide_data[,-c(2:4)]) |> 
  as.data.frame() 

# mz_rt should be the first column 
features_forQCcorr <- features_forQCcorr %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column() |>  # change samples from rownames to its own column
  row_to_names(row_number = 1) |>   # change the feature IDs (mz_rt) from first row obs into column names
  rename(mz_rt = sample_name) |> 
  separate(col = mz_rt,
           into = c("mz", "rt"),
           sep = "_") |> 
  mutate(N = 2:2173) |>
  select(N, mz, rt, everything())
```

## Constructing metaboset

Write out feature abundance df

```{r}
write_csv(x = features_forQCcorr,
          file = "Notame/fData.csv")
```


Wrangling pheno df

```{r}
pheno_df <- wide_data |> 
  select(sample_name, treatment, run_order) |> 
  t() |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  rownames_to_column(var = "variable")
```

Write out pheno df
```{r}

write_csv(x = pheno_df,
          file = "Notame/pData.csv")
```

Do some manual wrangling in Excel to make the Metaboset (see file in the folder).

```{r}

metaboset <- read_from_excel("Notame/metaboset.xlsx",
                             split_by = c("Column", "Ion Mode"))
```

Construct Metaboset

```{r}

modes <- construct_metabosets(exprs = metaboset$exprs,
                              pheno_data = metaboset$pheno_data,
                              feature_data = metaboset$feature_data, 
                              group_col = "treatment")
```

```{r}
# extract each mode into a single object
# even though we only have one mode here
mode <- modes$C18_Neg
```

```{r}
mode <- flag_detection(mode, qc_limit = 0.75, group_limit = 0.8)
```

## Applying drift correction
 
```{r}

corrected <- correct_drift(mode, log_transform = TRUE)

```

The output is percent of the features that were drift corrected. The remaining “low-quality” percent represents features for which the DC did not improve the RSD and D-ratio of the original data.

```{r}

inspected <- inspect_dc(orig = mode, dc = corrected, check_quality = TRUE)

```
Saving metaboset corrected.

```{r}

write_to_excel(corrected, "Notame/metaboset_corrected.xlsx")

```
```{r}
corrected_log <- corrected

exprs(corrected_log) <- log2(exprs(corrected_log))

mode_log <- mode

exprs(mode_log) <- log2(exprs(mode_log))
```


## Comparison between corrected vs uncorreceted

### Grouped by treatment

```{r}
(boxplot_before_correction <- 
   plot_sample_boxplots(mode_log, 
                        order_by = "treatment", 
                        title = "Uncorrected feature abundance"))
```

```{r}
(boxplot_after_correction <- 
   plot_sample_boxplots(corrected_log, 
                        order_by = "treatment", 
                        title = "Corrected feature abundance"))
```

```{r}
(Comparison <- ggpubr::ggarrange(boxplot_before_correction,
                                  boxplot_after_correction,
                                  ncol = 1, nrow = 2))
```


### Ordered by Injection order


```{r}
(boxplot_before_correction_run_order <- 
   plot_sample_boxplots(mode_log, 
                     order_by = "Injection_order", 
                     title = "Uncorrected feature abundance"))
```

```{r}
boxplot_after_correction_run_order <-
  plot_sample_boxplots(corrected_log, 
                     order_by = "Injection_order", 
                     title = "Corrected feature abundance")
```

```{r}
(Comparison_run_order <- ggpubr::ggarrange(boxplot_before_correction_run_order,
                                  boxplot_after_correction_run_order,
                                  ncol = 1, nrow = 2))
```
## Wrangling corrected data


```{r}
# save feature metadata
corrected_feature_metadata <- as.data.frame(corrected@featureData@data)

# save feature abundance data
corrected_feature_data <- as.data.frame(corrected@assayData[["exprs"]])

# replace ID_X names with samples names
colnames(corrected_feature_data) <- colnames(features_forQCcorr[-c(1:3)])

# bind back mz and rt
corrected_feature_metadata_mzrt <- corrected_feature_metadata |> 
  select(Mass, RT) 

# for metaboanalyst
corrected_feature_data_mzrt_formetaboanalyst <- 
  bind_cols(corrected_feature_metadata_mzrt, corrected_feature_data) |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  remove_rownames() |> 
  unite(col = "mz_rt", c("Mass", "RT"), sep = "_") # combine m/z & rt with _ in between
```

Prepare samples for remaining analysis

```{r}
corrected_feature_data_mzrt <- 
  bind_cols(corrected_feature_metadata_mzrt, corrected_feature_data) |> 
  remove_rownames() |> 
  rename(mz = Mass,
         rt = RT) |> 
  unite(mz_rt, mz:rt, sep = "_", remove = TRUE) |> 
  t() |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  rownames_to_column(var = "short_sample_name")

colnames(corrected_feature_data_mzrt) <- corrected_feature_data_mzrt[1,]

corrected_feature_data_mzrt <- corrected_feature_data_mzrt |> 
  rename(short_sample_name = 1) 

corrected_feature_data_mzrt <- corrected_feature_data_mzrt[-1,]

corrected_feature_data_mzrt <- corrected_feature_data_mzrt |> 
  mutate((across(.cols = 2:ncol(corrected_feature_data_mzrt), .fns = as.numeric)))
```

Add back metadata


```{r}
corrected_feature_wide <- 
  left_join(metadata, corrected_feature_data_mzrt,
            by = "short_sample_name")

corrected_feature_long <- corrected_feature_wide |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = 7:ncol(corrected_feature_wide),
               names_to = "mz_rt",
               values_to = "rel_abund") |> 
  separate(col = mz_rt, into = c("mz", "rt"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(across(.cols = c("mz", "rt"),
                       .fns = as.numeric))

corrected_feature_long[1:10, 1:10]
```

#### Log2 transformed

We will log2 transform our data.

```{r}
corrected_feature_long_log2 <- corrected_feature_long %>%
  mutate(rel_abund = log2(rel_abund))


corrected_feature_wide_log2 <- corrected_feature_long_log2 %>%
  select(-mz, -rt) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "mz_rt",
              values_from = "rel_abund")

```



```{r}

write_csv(x = corrected_feature_wide_log2,
          file = "Notame/corrected_feature_log2_wide.csv")

write_csv(x = corrected_feature_long_log2,
          file = "Notame/corrected_feature_log2_long.csv")

```
